verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Subscription Edits let ops apply or edit discounts on a single subscription, which loosely covers coupon-style pricing. Nothing in the pack shows free trials, promotion codes, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, or trial-end notifications. Missing for 10: free trial configuration, coupon/promotion code objects, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, card-network-compliant trial-end notifications, independent corroboration.
